name: ATC_ENTITLEMENT_METRICS
description: The user should be  able to define metrics as part of the service entitlement templates, This table wil be used for storing the metrics details

columns.name: ENT_METRIC_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the entitlement metric

columns.name: ENT_METRIC_PUID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the entitlement metric

columns.name: ENT_METRIC_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the name of the entitlement metric

columns.name: ENT_METRIC_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Short description of the entitlement metric

columns.name: ENT_METRIC_VALUE
columns.description: Indicates the value of the metric

columns.name: ENT_METRIC_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates that the service organization is committed to responding to issues to a certain time

columns.name: ENT_METRIC_PRIORITY
columns.description: Indicates the priority of the metric

columns.name: ENT_METRIC_UNITS
columns.description: Indicates measurement for the value field

columns.name: ENT_METRIC_SERVICE_HOURS
columns.description: Indicates the committed period to which the co responding metric will be adhered

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
